title: Rock Drake Origin
description:
Rock Drake Origin
Has Similar abilities to the one from Ark
body:
Rock Drake

Active Abilities:
Lunge - Sends player forward 30 blocks and up a couple, cooldown is 20 seconds
Camouflage -  toggles the player to blend in with their surroundings
Glide - Toggles the user to glide mode

Passive abilities:
Strong Arm - Is Naturally able to mine blocks up to deep slate
Sturdy Scales - takes reduced damage by default
Quick Footed - Has increased movement speed by default
High Jump - Can naturally jump 3 blocks up

Debuffs:
Carnivore - can only eat meat
Large Size - Character is Significantly taller
Bioluminescent -  Glows in dark environments
Raw Strength - No potions effect this player positive or negative


Required mods
Origins
Pehkui
Origins Extra Keybinds(HIGHLY RECCOMENDED)



Feel Free to use this in any modpack or other media's (yt videos), Just remember to link this page in the description
